cards.card_text: Then God says, "My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless."
cards.verse_text: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
cards.snippet: …sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.

cards.card_text: True or false: Moses says He leaves the fatherless and the widow to fend for themselves.
cards.verse_text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
cards.snippet: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.

cards.card_text: Foreigners, the fatherless and widows are left off the guest list for the Feast of Weeks.
cards.verse_text: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in the place He will choose as a dwelling for His Name—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
cards.snippet: …and the Levite within your gates, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.

cards.card_text: Then that guest list again, foreigner, fatherless and widows included.
cards.verse_text: And you shall rejoice in your feast—you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.
cards.snippet: …menservants and maidservants, and the Levite, as well as the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widows among you.

cards.card_text: Moses goes on: do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless, and do not take a widow's cloak as security.
cards.verse_text: Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless, and do not take a widow’s cloak as security.
cards.snippet: Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless, and do not take a widow’s cloak as security.

cards.card_text: What's left is for the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
cards.verse_text: It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
cards.snippet: It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you…

cards.card_text: That third-year tithe goes to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow, so they can eat and be filled within Israel's gates.
cards.verse_text: When you have finished laying aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you are to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat and be filled within your gates.
cards.snippet: …tithe, you are to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat and be filled within your…

cards.card_text: Then the giver declares before the LORD that the sacred portion is out of the house and given to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless and the widow.
cards.verse_text: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God, “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me.
cards.snippet: …sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me.

cards.card_text: Then three more people get named: cursed is he who withholds ___ from the foreigner, the fatherless or the widow.
cards.verse_text: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
cards.snippet: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’

cards.snippet: You sent widows away empty-handed, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.

cards.card_text: Then Job brings up the poor, the widow and the fatherless: what if he denied the desires of the poor, let a widow's eyes fail, or ate his morsel alone and never shared it with the fatherless?
cards.verse_text: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail, if I have eaten my morsel alone, not sharing it with the fatherless—
cards.snippet: …if I have eaten my morsel alone, not sharing it with the fatherless—

cards.card_text: Job asks what if he lifted his hand against the fatherless.
cards.verse_text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate,
cards.snippet: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate,

cards.snippet: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

cards.card_text: It asks that his days be few and another take his position, then it reaches his family: his wife a widow, his children fatherless beggars wandering far from their ruined homes.
cards.verse_text: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
cards.snippet: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

cards.card_text: The prayer asks that someone show favor to this man's fatherless children.
cards.verse_text: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
cards.snippet: …one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
